scope: isolated behavioral primitives and focused tests only; no resolver registration or certification

cards.name: Penguin Soldier
cards.officialText: FLIP: You can target up to 2 monsters on the field; return those targets to the hand.
cards.historicalEligibility: TCG printing is before the inclusive 2004-09-30 cutoff

cards.name: Hade-Hane
cards.officialText: FLIP: You can return up to 3 monsters on the field to the owner's hand.
cards.historicalEligibility: TCG printing is one day after the cutoff, but the official OCG printing is before the inclusive cutoff and qualifies under the project's TCG/OCG union.

twoVTwoAdaptation.fieldZone: separate and never treated as a monster target
twoVTwoAdaptation.controllerAndOwner: control team determines who resolves the FLIP effect; every returned monster goes to the private hand of its physical owner seat
twoVTwoAdaptation.penguinSoldier: target UIDs are fixed at activation; a target that leaves the field before resolution is not returned
twoVTwoAdaptation.hadeHane: non-targeting choices are made from the current field at resolution, up to three
twoVTwoAdaptation.privacy: face-down target identities are visible only to the physical owner; public and other-seat projections show a generic face-down label and never expose physical UIDs
twoVTwoAdaptation.handLimit: returned cards are added without immediate discard; the six-card hand limit is enforced only at that player's End Phase by the existing turn flow

limits: Helpers do not mutate the duel state or private hands.
No runtime/catalog/certification/Discord command files are changed.
Real 2v2 certification requires registration in the shared resolver and Discord handler tests after explicit handoff.
